sloka: तेन वामांसफलके भृशं प्रत्यवपादितम्।अङ्गदो मोक्षयामास सरोषः स परश्वधम् ।। ६.९९.१९ ।।
transliteration: tena vāmāṁsaphalake bhṛśaṁ pratyavapāditam।aṅgado mokṣayāmāsa saroṣaḥ sa paraśvadham ।। 6.99.19 ।।

translations.english: Angada, full of fury, escaped Mahaparsva's aim to strike his left shoulder blade in violence.
